About the Program

No matter if you’re facing chronic diseases, lifestyle-related issues, or various comorbidities in the post-covid era, Swasthya Anukūla Chikitsa at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village provides a highly individualized Ayurvedic healing experience. Based on traditional Ayurvedic literature and guided by experienced doctors, this program is customized to address your health issues, objectives, and constitution (prakriti).

Guests enjoy 2 Ayurvedic treatments daily, meticulously selected by our doctors following in-depth consultations and dosha evaluations. Therapies focus on lasting health, harmonizing bodily energies, and targeting underlying issues, not merely symptoms. Yoga, meditation, a pure diet, and Kerala’s therapeutic environment provide deep revitalization for the mind and body.

Our approach

to Customized Wellness

Kairali represents more than 115 years of Ayurvedic healing, drawing from Kerala’s rich medical lineage. Over 100,000 patients from 50+ countries have experienced authentic, doctor-supervised Ayurvedic therapies for a spectrum of health conditions.
